Screenshot: Login Page
This screenshot shows the FuelSight login page where users choose their portal role. The owner can sign in without selecting a branch, while manager and cashier accounts are branch-based.
Objective/s:
Objective 2: Provide a centralized web based invoicing and sales report for Greenfuel Gas Station.
Objective 3: Develop the application software through web-based technologies such as MySQL, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Objective 4: Test and evaluate the developed system using ISO 25010 Software Quality Standards in terms of functionality, usability, reliability, performance efficiency, and security.

Screenshot: Owner Dashboard
This screenshot shows the Owner Dashboard for centralized monitoring of branch sales, transactions, expenses, and branch performance.
Objective/s:
Objective 2.1: Synchronization of real-time sale information from all branches.
Objective 2.3: Sales records are monitored and analysis done graphically for sales.
Objective 2.6: Forecast and reports on branch performance.
